local_snapshot_notes: Publisher-only point-in-time copy of every External-tab row (all 14 columns). Not a runtime dependency and not included in the standalone bundle. Only authorized publishers refresh it under staleness_check; public users use the published catalog and live public-source checks.
access_notes: This workbook is IRM/RMS-protected (Azure Information Protection), not just link-gated. A plain HTTP fetch of the sharing URL returns 401, and downloading the raw bytes and parsing them with a local library (e.g. openpyxl) fails because the content is cryptographically sealed. The only way to read it is through a Microsoft 365 service that can honor the user's RMS license (e.g. Copilot/workiq acting under the signed-in user's identity). Resolve the sharing link to a direct item webUrl first if needed, then ask that service to read the 'External' worksheet in small batches (~10 rows at a time) to avoid truncation.
expected_columns: Priority to add to context library

staleness_check.on_expiry: Authorized publishers re-run workiq-retrieve + workiq-ask against workbook_url (External worksheet only), refresh this folder's snapshot and observed_date/observed_range/observed_record_count, and rederive catalog.json priorities. Do not request this from runtime users.
